title: Kingdoms, Ranks and Scientific Names
summary: Whittaker's five kingdoms, the hierarchy from kingdom to species, and binomial nomenclature.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 12: Patterns in Life: Diversity and Classification
Earlier NCERT (before 2023): Diversity in Living Organisms

objectives: I can describe the five kingdoms and their key features.
I can list the ranks of classification in order.
I can write scientific names correctly.
misconceptions: Two organisms in the same class are closer relatives than two in the same genus.
Scientific names can be written any way.
